visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A black-and-white bicolor cat is seen sleeping deeply on its side atop a light-colored wooden shelf. The shelf is part of a modular furniture system against a plain, off-white wall background. The cat's head rests on the edge of the wood, its eyes closed and ears twitching slightly. Sunlight provides a bright, natural illumination to the scene. (2) A human hand enters the frame from the right side, holding a pair of professional-style cat nail clippers with grey handles and a spring-loaded metal cutting head. The hand's skin is fair, and it gently reaches out to touch one of the cat's white paws which is dangling slightly over the edge of the shelf. (3) The hand positions the metal clippers around one of the cat's claws on its front right paw. The cat slowly opens its eyes, which are a yellowish-green color, looking directly toward the camera with a groggy expression. The hand stops movement momentarily as the cat stares blankly before eventually closing its eyes again to return to sleep. (4) The owner successfully clips one of the cat's nails while it remains still. The hand then gently pets the cat's forehead and ears to soothe it. The cat's pink nose is visible as it breathes steadily. The lighting remains consistent and bright throughout the interaction on the wooden shelf. (5) After a brief moment, the hand attempts to clip another nail. The cat wakes up again, looks surprised, and lifts its head slightly to observe the hand and the tool. The hand is shown holding the grey clippers ready for action. The cat looks back and forth before settling down once more, seemingly too tired to resist. (6) In the final phase, the person manages to clip three nails in total. The cat is shown sleeping peacefully with its head tucked in and eyes tightly shut. A pink screen appears at the very end with white text in the center, signifying the conclusion of the video clip in a branded style.
